title: Red Canoe: the lake's new look
kaylee: Moraine Lake looks like the Nan trip now: real spruces, pink fireweed and mossy boulders round the water, a glacier made of ice, and a creek that tumbles down a waterfall into the lake (and splashes louder as she paddles near).
